# Tender Tokens Studio

Tender Tokens Studio is the sketchbook practice of San Francisco artist Christine Pelaez. It's hand lettering, collage, and marker drawings made from the paper scraps of everyday life and travel: receipts, labels, napkins, tickets, boarding passes, and notes. Every page is signed "cmp" and dated down to the minute. The work is personal, tactile, and rooted in the idea that small paper scraps carry big feelings.

## What's here

A one-page portfolio of finished sketchbook pages from San Francisco, Kenya, Mallorca, and elsewhere, with links to where new work is posted.

## Tone

Warm, handmade, quietly whimsical. Not corporate. Not minimal. Feels like a note written with a good pen on nice paper.

## Technical note

This is a static HTML/CSS/JS site with no backend and no user accounts. The shop lives on Etsy; the site only links to it.
